svg.title: A narrow body can have few points but useful density
svg.desc: A two square metre body contains eight roof observations, giving four points per square metre. An excessive inward buffer removes its sampling area. Keeping support allows a reliable low height to be retained when the observations agree.
svg.text: Few observations need not mean poor coverage
Illustrative plan · the body's footprint remains unchanged in the output
Evaluate count, density and agreement in roof elevation together.
A low, well-supported body can keep its measured height even if storey data suggest more.
Without enough reliable evidence, use an explicit fallback or leave the height unresolved.
